votes.reason: Active application contour, actual native keyboard recipient halo and unconfirmed input scope are independent; admitted chooser ownership does not fabricate application typing focus.

Candidate corners/dashes and label remain separate from active/input/control focus; a valid newer B focus observation is admitted even after shell candidate moves to C; retired incarnations are not reused.
Neutral role-based shadows preserve committed native scene geometry/order and covering-surface clipping; focus decoration does not lift a window or enlarge native input regions.
Shading is confined to opaque owned chrome or shell backplates and preserves client pixels, content readability, geometry and input eligibility.
Native family brackets and labels avoid shared-PID/title inference; optional short-bracket glow is weak and cannot claim input focus or eligibility.
Modal/block/pin glyphs and reasons remain independent; only the admitted blocked owner chrome is shaded and unrelated focus/input policy is preserved.
Pending/Refused/Cancelled/Unknown retain correlated targets and readable status; focus facts can update separately without settling or replaying Unknown.
Ineligible/minimized/retired/fully covered desktop effects are suppressed under native scene facts while separate shell entries preserve authorized preview meanings.
Essential state uses opaque controlled backing, visible non-color cues and measured text/non-text adjacent-background contrast rather than halo-only indicators.
Qualified preferences retain equivalent information, native target identity, unresolved obligations and original deadlines; effects-off cannot become a second policy.
Frozen brand palette and thirty earlier design contracts are retained; additive tokens reserve major glows for eligible window/shell scope and preserve ordinary control/logo treatment.
Static-at-rest effects have finite recipe caps and no decorative recurring clock; actual S02 budgets, generations, physical retirement and original deadlines remain required.
Effective Omarchy vocabulary, arguments, chooser/immediate-cycle behavior, user overrides and release/consumption/popup/IME ownership remain unchanged; appearance creates no new effect.
The single Elm policy authority and admitted native facts remain explicit; model/browser/token evidence cannot replace the coherent owning tuple or original full-release native gates.

scope: Accepts exact additive design target packet only; implementation and native/full-release qualification remain open.
